ocular.name: Ocular & SANS Monitoring
ocular.subtitle: Spaceflight-Associated Neuro-ocular Syndrome
ocular.whyMeasurement: Microgravity shifts ~2L of fluid toward the head, increasing pressure behind the eyes. Daily optical tracking detects early optic nerve swelling before it causes permanent visual changes.
ocular.mechanism: Spaceflight-Associated Neuro-ocular Syndrome (SANS) results from loss of hydrostatic pressure gradient in microgravity, generating a persistent ~1.5–2.0 L cephalad fluid shift. Intraocular venous engorgement increases optic nerve sheath diameter (ONSD) and optic disc thickness.

cardio.name: Cardiovascular & Hemodynamics
cardio.subtitle: Arterial Baroreflex & Central Venous Equilibrium
cardio.whyMeasurement: In weightlessness, blood volume redistributes and the heart works against less resistance. Tracking blood pressure and heart rate ensures the heart muscle and arterial reflexes maintain healthy tone.
cardio.mechanism: Cephalic fluid redistribution initially expands central blood volume, leading to neuro-humoral down-regulation of plasma volume (~12%). Countermeasure exercise preserves ventricular compliance and orthostatic tolerance for atmospheric re-entry.

cranial.name: Neuro-Vestibular Adaptation
cranial.subtitle: Otolith Asymmetry & Spatial Orientation
cranial.whyMeasurement: The inner ear vestibular organs lose gravity cues in space, confusing balance and gaze stabilization. Tracking the reflex verifies that the brain balance centers are adapting safely.
cranial.mechanism: In 0g, gravity cues from otolith organs (utricle and saccule) dissociate from semicircular canal signals. Sensory conflict resolves after 72–96 hours through cerebellar plastic reweighting.

spine.name: Axial Spine & Musculoskeletal
spine.subtitle: Intervertebral Disc Hydration & Height Elongation
spine.whyMeasurement: Without gravity compressing spinal discs, astronauts spines can elongate up to 5 cm, risking back strain and disc herniation during vigorous work or landing.
spine.mechanism: Lack of gravitational axial compression allows intervertebral discs to imbibe fluid and expand, causing 2–5 cm stature elongation and paraspinal flattening.

pulmonary.name: Pulmonary Gas Exchange & Atmosphere
pulmonary.subtitle: Alveolar Ventilation & Ambient pCO2 Matching
pulmonary.whyMeasurement: Without gravity-driven convection, exhaled carbon dioxide can form pockets around sleeping or working crew. Monitoring SpO2 and ambient CO2 ensures clean oxygenation.
pulmonary.mechanism: Absence of natural thermal air convection causes localized exhaled CO2 pooling if ventilation is impaired. Ventilation-perfusion matching remains homogeneous in 0g.

limbs.name: Lower Limbs & Venous Return
limbs.subtitle: Soleus & Gastrocnemius Density Countermeasures
limbs.whyMeasurement: Weight-bearing leg muscles quickly lose mass and tone when not walking under 1g. Regular measurements verify that daily treadmill and resistive exercises are preventing muscle atrophy.
limbs.mechanism: Anti-gravity postural muscles (slow-twitch soleus) undergo rapid deconditioning if not actively loaded against microgravity. Resistive deadlifts maintain bone and muscle mass.

neuro.name: Brain & Behavioral Health
neuro.subtitle: Psychomotor Vigilance & Cognitive Latency
neuro.whyMeasurement: Cognitive alertness and motor speed can degrade under microgravity fluid shifts, circadian fatigue, and high workload. Daily PVT tracks neuro-behavioral readiness.
neuro.mechanism: Sleep debt, circadian desynchrony, and microgravity cephalic venous engorgement increase neural reaction latency and attention lapses > 500 ms.

sleep.name: Sleep Architecture & Circadian
sleep.subtitle: Polysomnography & Melatonin Phase Alignment
sleep.whyMeasurement: 90-minute orbital light cycles and spacecraft ambient noise disrupt deep slow-wave sleep. Tracking daily sleep duration guards against cumulative sleep debt.
sleep.mechanism: Loss of 24h natural solar zeitgeber and circadian temperature rhythms dampens endogenous melatonin secretion, shortening total sleep time by 1–1.5 hours/night.

immune.name: Immune & Cosmic Radiation
immune.subtitle: Ionizing Particle Dose & Cellular Immunity
immune.whyMeasurement: Deep space galactic cosmic radiation and solar particle events damage DNA and suppress T-cell function. Daily dosimetric tracking safeguards biological thresholds.
immune.mechanism: Ionizing radiation creates double-strand DNA breaks and reactive oxygen species, coupled with microgravity-induced down-regulation of T-cell activation markers.

metabolic.name: Metabolic Core & Thermoregulation
metabolic.subtitle: Microgravity Space Fever & Endocrine Homeostasis
metabolic.whyMeasurement: Without thermal air convection, sweat does not evaporate efficiently, causing core body temperatures to elevate by ~1°C (spaceflight hyperthermia).
metabolic.mechanism: Lack of gravitational air convection impairs radiant and evaporative heat loss from the skin, raising resting setpoint core temperature during flight.
